mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate above 3.5% signals monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Real retail sales (RSAFS) declining below $660 billion signals weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of instances when RSAFS < 660000.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates labor market overheating with supply constraints, increasing inflation expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of instances when PAYEMS grows and INDPRO declines, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising >0.3pp over 3 months) increases real interest rates, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of instances during tightening cycles, or Rank IC < 0.03 for regime-conditional signal.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tight labor market that increases wage pressures and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in >60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) declining below 100.0 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in >60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
